title: Peanuts
description: I added Peanuts to the game. This resource pack is for my personal use on the Simplecraft SMP but you can use it too.....
body: This pack changes the sweet berrie bushes into peanut plants. The red berries have been replace with small yellow flowers, and the sweet berries have been replaced with Peanuts. This is a resource pack created by youtuber MC. ivan for the SimpleCraft SMP. You are able to use it as well.
